question: Explain the fundamental principles of professional ethics that a Chartered Accountant must follow under the ICAI Code of Ethics.
sources: ICAI Code of Ethics (fundamental principles, based on the IESBA Code)

points.label: Integrity
points.description: Being straightforward and honest in all professional and business relationships, and not being associated with false or misleading information.
points.basis: ICAI Code of Ethics, fundamental principle of integrity

points.label: Objectivity
points.description: Not allowing bias, conflict of interest or undue influence of others to override professional judgement.
points.basis: ICAI Code of Ethics, fundamental principle of objectivity

points.label: Professional competence and due care
points.description: Keeping professional knowledge and skill at the level needed to give competent service, and acting diligently under applicable standards.
points.basis: ICAI Code of Ethics, fundamental principle of professional competence and due care

points.label: Confidentiality
points.description: Respecting the confidentiality of information obtained through work, and not disclosing or using it for personal gain without proper authority, unless there is a legal or professional duty to disclose.
points.basis: ICAI Code of Ethics, fundamental principle of confidentiality

points.label: Professional behaviour
points.description: Complying with laws and regulations and avoiding any action that discredits the profession.
points.basis: ICAI Code of Ethics, fundamental principle of professional behaviour
